suppress.notes: All IntelliJ Platform bundled dependencies (Netty, Protobuf, Commons-IO, XStream, etc.) are shipped as part of the platform distribution and cannot be upgraded independently. Vulnerabilities in these libraries must be addressed by JetBrains in a platform release. This plugin runs inside the IDE JVM process and does not expose platform internals over a network boundary or to untrusted input. Review when upgrading to IntelliJ IDEA 2025.1+ where JetBrains may have addressed outstanding CVEs. Current platform: IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3 (build 243).

False positive: OWASP misidentifies jsch-agent-proxy as the netcat utility (nc). jsch-agent-proxy is a Java SSH-agent proxy library used by the IntelliJ Platform's Git integration; it shares no code with netcat and none of the netcat CVEs apply.
False positive: OWASP misidentifies cli-parser (a Java CLI argument parsing library) as the GitHub CLI tool (gh). The CVEs assigned to the GitHub CLI binary do not apply to this pure-Java library.
False positive: OWASP misidentifies ktlint-cli-reporter (a Kotlin linting report formatter) as Apache Checkstyle. ktlint shares no code with Checkstyle and none of the Checkstyle CVEs apply.

CVE-2023-6378 is a deserialization vulnerability in Logback 1.4.7 (logback-classic and logback-core). These are bundled inside verifier-cli-1.400-all.jar, which is the JetBrains IntelliJ Plugin Verifier tool used only at build time to validate plugin compatibility. This JAR is never shipped as part of the plugin distribution and is not present at plugin runtime. The vulnerability requires an attacker to control the Logback configuration file, which is not possible in a build-time-only tool. Suppressed until 2026-12-01; re-evaluate if a newer verifier-cli release ships with a patched Logback version.

CVE-2020-27225 is a remote code execution vulnerability in Eclipse Platform's XML external entity processing. lsp4ij 0.19.1 embeds an Eclipse LSP4E component that triggers this CVE match. This plugin uses lsp4ij only as a client-side IDE integration layer; it does not parse untrusted XML or expose any Eclipse Platform HTTP endpoints. The CVE affects the Eclipse IDE application shell, not the LSP client library. Suppressed until 2026-06-01; re-evaluate if a newer lsp4ij release ships with an updated Eclipse component.
